newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK ALCO SAYS 96 PROFITS ROSE 48PCT TO 444MLN DRS.
newsitem.headline: GREEK ALCO SAYS 96 PROFITS ROSE 48PCT TO 444MLN DRS.

text.p: Greek Alco aluminum firm said in a statement that its pretax profits rose 48 percent to 444 million drachmas in 1996 from 300 million in 1995 and its sales 19.4 percent to 3.72 billion drachmas from 3.123 billion in 1995.
The firm will pay a dividend per share of 40 drachmas for fiscal 1996, it said.

Its gross revenues increased to 1.11 billion drachmas in the first quarter of 1997 from 846 million the same period a year earlier and its pretax profits grew to 146 million drachmas from 105 million in the first quarter of 1995, it said.
Alco is listed on the Athens bourse's parallel market. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
